vaults.name: Reach, Mandate, Gap
vaults.what: A vault app: pick an example agent, tick what it is authorised to do, and see the gap between its reach and its mandate. Self-contained, read-only, audited before publication.

vaults.name: Who reads web-summit.sgit.ai: the application
vaults.what: The observability app (WS-37), code only and no data: Overview and an in-vault drain, run by the private data vault that links it. Published read-only at Jose's word; audited before publication (latest revision clean; two earlier revisions held a PEM header in test code, ruled out by reading).

vaults.name: Agent policy explorer
vaults.what: A vault app: every agent on the team's Reach, Mandate, Gap and Barriers, from the 44 published ABPs, one agent at a time or the whole team side by side. Self-contained, no permissions, built like sgit.ai's Risk graph explorer; audited before publication.
